images.title: Powers in three cards
images.purpose: Sums up the chapter in three cards: what a power means, one exponent rule, and standard form.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three equal cards side by side, each with a short heading and one line.
images.exact_structure: Three equal white cards in a row with thin outlines: the first teal (#0072B2), headed power, reading 2³ = 2 × 2 × 2; the second amber (#E69F00), headed rule, reading 2³ × 2² = 2⁵; the third reddish purple (#CC79A7), headed standard form, reading 308100000 = 3.081 × 10⁸. Exactly 3 cards. Nothing else.
